smooth_f5.midnightconfig.title: Smooth F5
smooth_f5.midnightconfig.smoothingMode.t: Controls when Smooth F5 is active: transitions only, movement only, both, or disabled.
smooth_f5.midnightconfig.followSpace.too: World Space gives pure trailing smoothing; Movement-Centered keeps movement locked and smooths rotation orbit; Rotation-Centered keeps rotation locked and lets movement pull free from the camera.
Enable smoothing in standard third-person back view.
smooth_f5.midnightconfig.smoothFrontView: Enable smoothing in mirrored third-person front view.
smooth_f5.midnightconfig.posResponsivene: Higher values follow the player more tightly with less lag; lower values feel softer and more cinematic.
smooth_f5.midnightconfig.verticalRespons: Multiplier for vertical smoothing speed (stairs, slabs, jumping) relative to horizontal speed.
smooth_f5.midnightconfig.adaptiveSpeed.t: Increases responsiveness when sprinting, boating, or flying so the camera never falls far behind.
smooth_f5.midnightconfig.adaptiveSpeedBo: How strongly responsiveness increases at high speeds when Adaptive Speed Smoothing is enabled.
smooth_f5.midnightconfig.minPlayerDistan: Prevents the camera from getting closer than this fraction of vanilla distance or crossing behind the player when sprinting toward the camera.
Maximum distance the smoothed camera may lag behind the target position.
smooth_f5.midnightconfig.preventWallClip: Clips the smoothed camera position against solid blocks so it never passes inside walls.
Snaps inward immediately when hitting a wall, then smoothly eases back out once space clears.
smooth_f5.midnightconfig.enableRotSmooth: Smoothly damps mouse rotation during third-person gameplay (perspective transitions always animate rotation smoothly).
smooth_f5.midnightconfig.rotResponsivene: Higher values follow mouse rotation faster with less delay.
smooth_f5.midnightconfig.transitionStyle: ORBIT swings smoothly around the player when switching Back <-> Front; EASE_OUT zooms cleanly out from the player's head instead of passing through it.
smooth_f5.midnightconfig.transitionDurat: Duration of third-person perspective transitions in milliseconds.
smooth_f5.midnightconfig.firstPersonRetu: Duration when returning to first-person view in milliseconds.
